683:t_010:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You might call it the $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$.」

683:t_010:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Our world... created that $$変動重力源$$...」

683:t_010:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You needn't feel responsible for that.」

683:t_010:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「If anything deserves blame, it's the force that seeks to vanish, which evolved the $$宇宙怪獣$$ across parallel worlds to bring about the universe's great collapse.」

683:t_010:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you want? Did you come to tell us what the $$宇宙怪獣$$ really are?」

683:t_010:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Here is my answer.」

683:t_011:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now... black emissaries. Punish Earth's humanity.」

683:t_011:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「You don't care if the universe is destroyed?!」

683:t_011:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We will decide the universe's future anew. And to us, you are more important than $$バアル$$'s existence.」

683:t_011:5.en:
???
「Is that all, $$喜びのアドヴェント$$?」

683:t_012:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「You came back pretty damn fast!」

683:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「By deliberately taking the $$御使い$$s' power, I mastered the use of my four $$スフィア$$s.」

683:t_012:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

683:t_012:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Thank you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. Just what I'd expect from the original owner of the $$スフィア$$s and the oldest higher-dimensional life-form...」

683:t_012:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And from one of the $$御使い$$s who burdened me with this cursed destiny.」

683:t_012:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're saying the $$御使い$$s made that bastard immortal too?!」

683:t_012:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「How contemptible, $$アサキム$$. By feeding my $$ヘリオース$$' power back into yourself, you've become one with the $$スフィア$$s.」

683:t_012:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes! And the black wings will transcend destiny and atone for Heaven's sin!」

683:t_014:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「C-Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Please save the universe!!」

683:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$. How dare you take $$ブルー$$'s life.」

683:t_016:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Drop the cheap act, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. There's no heat in your anger.」

683:t_016:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even you seem determined to keep them from entering your own universe.」

683:t_016:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You mean their own universe?」

683:t_016:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The entrance to the universe they inhabit is here at the galactic center.」

683:t_016:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$アサキム$$ is correct.」

683:t_016:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「At the center of the Milky Way is a pillar that pierces every parallel world... the $$天柱$$.」

683:t_016:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「To put it in terms you can understand, it is an elevator connecting floors, each of which is a parallel world.」

683:t_016:13.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The $$天柱$$... It pierces every parallel world...」

683:t_016:14.en:
$$桂$$
「The universe's great collapse, once every 120 million years...! Does it happen through that $$天柱$$?!」

683:t_016:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly, you $$始原の特異点$$s. You instinctively sensed where your sin lies.」

683:t_016:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But passing through it requires power sufficient to transcend this universe's natural order. Knowing about it won't let you do anything about it.」

683:t_016:17.en:
$n
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Are you running away?!」

683:t_016:18.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am always watching over you. Yes, I will continue to do so.」

683:t_016:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Farewell, $c. I'll be waiting for you to pass through the $$天柱$$.」

683:t_017:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「That bastard! How much more does he have to look down on us before he's satisfied?!」

683:t_017:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Stop! Right now, dealing with that gigantic $$変動重力源$$ comes first!」

683:t_018:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$...!」

683:t_018:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We can't save the universe unless we defeat it!」

683:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「We can't stop the $$時空震動弾$$ from detonating! If we don't defeat it before that, the operation fails!」

683:t_018:3.en:
$$アスラン$$
「We have to fight that monster... with $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$s here too...!」

683:t_018:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to lack confidence.」

683:t_018:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$アサキム$$.」

683:t_018:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We swore we'd fight to the end, no matter what enemy appeared!」

683:t_018:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll deal with you later. Just stay out of the way.」

683:t_018:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... I'll fight alongside you too.」

683:t_018:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't screw with us! Who the hell would want your help?!」

683:t_018:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm not helping you. I'll fight for the universe too... That's all.」

683:t_018:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... We cannot trust you.」

683:t_018:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But for now, we'll accept your help.」

683:t_018:15.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then it's settled! Let's do this!」

683:t_018:16.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our target is the $$エグゼリオ変動重力源$$!」

683:t_019:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We'll bring it down from that single point...!」

683:t_019:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「No matter how huge the enemy is, as long as it's alive, we should be able to defeat it!」

683:t_019:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's go, everyone! If we've put everything into the fight so far...」

683:t_019:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then from here on, we'll fight beyond our limits!」

683:t_019:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll do it! If victory lies beyond those limits!!」

683:t_019:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'll do it! If victory lies beyond those limits!!」

683:t_019:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'll do it! If victory lies beyond those limits!!」

683:t_020:0.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「It really is one hell of a monster! So this won't be easy!」

683:t_020:1.en:
$$シベラ$$
「A fleet is approaching from behind! It's... reinforcements from Earth!」

683:t_020:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet's second wave! You came!」
